# MTG AI Commander — Verdict

> A free companion app for Magic: The Gathering Commander (EDH) on iOS and Android.
> It audits a decklist card by card against the real Oracle text from Scryfall,
> answers rules questions, finds combos, generates decks, and tracks life for 2-6
> players. No ads, no subscription; the AI features run on the player's own API key.

How the deck analysis works, and why it differs from asking a chatbot: deterministic
code does the counting (lands, ramp, card draw, removal, mana curve, colour sources,
and contradictions between stated goals and the actual list), and the exact current
Oracle text of every card is fetched from Scryfall and given to the model as data, so
it quotes cards instead of recalling them.

Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Catalan.
